one_line: A powerful 17th‑century merchant of Mughal Surat, navigating Indian Ocean trade and imperial politics.

appearance.age_look: Late 40s to mid 50s, medium height, slightly stout but solidly built, with a composed merchant’s posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with a high forehead, warm medium‑brown complexion, neatly trimmed salt‑and‑pepper beard and moustache, sharp observant eyes under slightly arched brows, a thin tilak line at the center of his forehead, default expression calm and calculating with a hint of a knowing half‑smile.
appearance.hair: Dark hair turning grey at the temples, cut short and combed back but mostly hidden under a soft white cotton turban wrapped in the late‑Mughal Gujarati style, with a subtle pale‑gold border along the turban edge and a small tucked tail at the back.
appearance.costume: Long, knee‑length angarkha of fine off‑white cotton with a faint diagonal weave, overlapping to the right and tied with inner strings, worn over a light saffron‑yellow cotton jama‑style under‑tunic; a sleeveless, slightly longer, deep maroon silk waistcoat (sadri) with simple gold piping and small cloth toggles; loose white cotton churidar trousers gathered at the ankles; a narrow dark‑green wool shawl draped over his left shoulder; simple brown leather mojari shoes with upturned toes; minimal jewellery limited to a thin gold ring on his right hand, a black‑thread amulet cord just visible at the neck, and a small cloth pouch at his waist tied with a red cord, all in line with a wealthy yet practical merchant of Mughal‑era Surat.
appearance.signature: A polished dark‑wood writing board held in his left hand, with a folded piece of thick paper, a reed pen, and a cotton string of bead‑counters wrapped around it, symbolising his merchant ledgers and calculations.

ref_desc: Virji Vora is a late‑middle‑aged, medium‑brown, sharp‑eyed merchant with a neat salt‑and‑pepper beard, short hair under a white turban with pale‑gold border, wearing an off‑white angarkha, saffron under‑tunic, deep maroon waistcoat, white churidar, dark‑green shawl, brown mojari shoes, and carrying a dark‑wood writing board with reed pen and bead‑counters.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full‑body anime‑style model sheet of a dignified late‑middle‑aged Indian merchant from 17th‑century Mughal Surat named Virji Vora: he has an oval face, warm medium‑brown skin, sharp observant eyes, a high forehead with a thin tilak line, and a neatly trimmed salt‑and‑pepper beard and moustache; his short dark hair, greying at the temples, is mostly covered by a soft white cotton turban wrapped in a Gujarati Mughal style with a subtle pale‑gold border along the edge and a small tucked tail at the back. Dress him in an off‑white cotton angarkha reaching just below the knees, overlapping to the right and tied with inner strings, over a light saffron‑yellow under‑tunic; add a sleeveless, slightly longer deep maroon silk waistcoat with simple gold piping and cloth toggle closures. His trousers are loose white cotton churidar gathered at the ankles, and he wears simple brown leather mojari shoes with gently upturned toes. Drape a narrow dark‑green wool shawl over his left shoulder; keep jewellery minimal with a thin gold ring on his right hand and a discreet black‑thread amulet cord just visible at the neck, plus a small cloth pouch tied at his waist with a red cord. In his left hand he holds a polished dark‑wood writing board with a folded sheet of thick paper, a reed pen, and a cotton string of bead‑counters wrapped around it, emphasizing his role as a meticulous merchant. Use a restrained palette of off‑white, deep maroon, saffron yellow, dark green, and brown leather, and present front, side, and back views to clearly show his consistent face, turban, garments, and signature writing board prop.
